answer.value: Trained on publicly available third-party datasets, as referenced in the technical report and the Molmo2 data collection of highly-curated image-text and video-text pairs. The card notes these third-party datasets are subject to academic and non-commercial research use only. It does not describe annotation or synthetic-data generation methods, or how rights were obtained.
quotes: Molmo2 models are trained on publicly available third party datasets as referenced in [our technical report](https://allenai.org/papers/molmo2) and [Molmo2 data](https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/molmo2-data),
a collection of datasets with highly-curated image-text and video-text pairs.
